```{r}
skills = arules::read.transactions(   # Job Scout skills: one posting = one basket
  'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmegahed/isa401/main/data/class25_job_skills_2026-11-15.csv',
  format = 'single', sep = ',', header = TRUE, cols = c('posting_id', 'skill'))
 
arules::summary(skills)
 
arules::itemFrequency(skills) # returns frequency in alphabetic order
arules::itemFrequency(skills) |> sort(decreasing = TRUE)
 
arules::itemFrequencyPlot(skills, support = 0.1)
arules::itemFrequencyPlot(skills, topN = 20)
 
# mine association rules with a certain min support and confidence
skill_rules = arules::apriori(
  skills, parameter = list(
    support = 0.2, confidence = 0.5, minlen = 2, maxlen = 5)  )
 
arules::summary(skill_rules)
arules::inspect(skill_rules)
 
arules::sort(skill_rules, by = 'lift', decreasing = TRUE)[1:3] |> arules::inspect()
```
```{r}
# internal to arulesViz, hence the :::
arulesViz:::plot.rules(skill_rules,
  measure = c('support', 'lift'),
  shading = 'confidence')
```
```{r}
# top 5 rules by lift, as a graph
skill_rules |>
  arules::head(n = 5, by = 'lift') |>
  arulesViz:::plot.rules(method = 'graph')
```


```{r}
skills = readr::read_csv(paste0(
  'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmegahed/isa401/main/data/',
  'class25_job_skills_2026-11-15.csv'))
 
skills # one row per posting and skill
```
```{r}
dplyr::n_distinct(skills$posting_id) # number of postings
```
```{r}
top30 = skills |> dplyr::count(skill, sort = TRUE) |> dplyr::slice_head(n = 30)
 
# one row per posting, a 0/1 column for each of the top 30 skills
postings = skills |>
  dplyr::filter(skill %in% top30$skill) |>
  dplyr::distinct(posting_id, skill) |>
  dplyr::mutate(has = 1) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = skill, values_from = has, values_fill = 0)
 
x = postings |> dplyr::select(-posting_id) # the input to k-means: no label, no id
 
x[1:4, 1:6]
```
```{r}
set.seed(2026)
km_res_nbclust = NbClust::NbClust(
  data = x,
  distance = "euclidean",
  min.nc = 2, max.nc = 8,
  method = "kmeans", index ="all") # about a minute
 
table(km_res_nbclust$Best.partition) # postings per cluster
```

```{r}
factoextra::fviz_cluster(
  object =
    list(
      cluster = km_res_nbclust$Best.partition,
      data = x
    ),
  geom = "point",
  ellipse.type = "convex",
  palette = "jco",
  ggtheme = ggplot2::theme_minimal()
)
```
```{r}
# NbClust's clusters, saved with each posting's title, company, location, link and skills
clusters = readr::read_csv(paste0(
  'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmegahed/isa401/main/data/',
  'class26_job_clusters_2026-11-15.csv'))
 
clusters |> dplyr::count(cluster) # postings per cluster
 
clusters |> # the jobs in one cluster; change 1 to see the others
  dplyr::filter(cluster == 1) |>
  dplyr::select(title, company, apply_url)
```
